title: Raiders rule Brock Bowers out with an ankle injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Raiders rule Brock Bowers out with an ankle injury
sources.description: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers dealt with an ankle injury throughout the first half of Sunday's game against the Seahawks and he will not return to the game in the second half.
